source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Place the original grid in the center and reflect it into the
    # surrounding copies along each axis.
    indices = list(range(n - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(n)) + list(range(n - 1, -1, -1))
    return [[grid[indices[r]][indices[c]] for c in range(3 * n)] for r in range(3 * n)]
